original: anutpannaputrasya cāyaṃ niyamaḥ: “brāhmaṇo ha vai jāyamānas tribhir ṛṇair ṛṇavā jāyate yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ svādhyāyenarṣibhyaḥ” ity etat pratyakṣaśrutimūlatve ‘sya saṃbhavati mūlāntarakalpanasyāyuktatvāt | “tasmād yugmāsu putrārthī saṃviśed ārtave striyam” (3.48) iti ca vakṣyati | tato ‘py etacchrutimūltvam avagamyate | putrotpādanaśāstrasya caikaputrotpādanenaiva caritārthatvāt “kāmajān itarān viduḥ” (9.107) iti darśanād ajātaputrasyaiva niyamaḥ | “daśāsyāṃ putrān ādhehi” iti mantras tu bahuputrapraśaṃsāparaḥ | jātaputrasyāpy ṛtukālagamananiyamo na daśasv evāvatiṣṭhate | svadāranirataḥ sadeti “nityaṃ svadārasaṃtuṣṭaḥ syān nānyabhāryām upagacched” iti vidhānāt parisaṃkhyaiva | vākyānarthakyāt svadāragamanasya praśastatvāt | ṛtāv agamane doṣaśravaṇāc ca niyamavidhiḥ: “parvavarjaṃ vrajec cainām” iti | parvāṇy amāvāsyādīni vakṣyante | tāni varjayitvā bhāryāprītivrataṃ yasya sa tadvrato ‘nṛtāv apy upeyāt | ata eva ratikāmyayā na tu putrotpādanaśāstrabuddhyā | tasmād vidhitrayam idam – ṛtāv upeyād eva, anyabhāryāṃ nopagacchet, anṛtāv api bhāryāprītaye gacched iti | atra ca gautamaḥ: “ṛtāv upeyād anṛtau ca parvavarjam” (GDh 5.1) | yājñavalkyo ‘py āha (1.81):
analyzed: an utpanna putrasya ca ayam niyamaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ ha vai jāyamānaḥ tribhiḥ ṛṇaiḥ ṛṇavā jāyate yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ svādhyāyena ṛṣibhyaḥ iti etat pratyakṣa śruti mūla tve sya saṃbhavati mūla antara kalpanasya ayukta tvāt tasmāt yugmāsu putra arthī saṃviśet ārtave striyam iti ca vakṣyati tatas u pi etad śruti mūl tvam avagamyate putra utpādana śāstrasya ca eka putra utpādanena eva caritārtha tvāt kāma jān itarān viduḥ iti darśa

original: yad iti | garhitena karmaṇā niṣiddhaduṣpratigrahādinā brāhmaṇā yad dhanam arjayanti tasya dhanasya tyāgena japatapobhyāṃ vakṣyamāṇābhyāṃ śudhyanti | dhanatyāgena ca prāyaścittavidhānād bahumūlye ca karituragādāv alpamūlye ca lohādau parigṛhīte tulyaprāyaścittābhidhānam upapannam | evam avikrayyāvikryādāv api || 11.193 ||

original: upavāsakṛśaṃ taṃ tu govrajāt punar āgatam |
analyzed: upavāsa kṛśam tam tu govrajāt punar āgatam

original: upavāseti | kevalakṣīrāhāreṇa itarabhojanavyāvṛttyā kṛśadehaṃ goṣṭhāt pratyāgataṃ praṇataṃ namrībhūtaṃ ‘kim asmābhiḥ saha sāmyam icchasi, punar asatpratigrahaṃ na kariṣyasi’ ity evaṃ dharmaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ paripṛccheyuḥ || 11.195 ||

original: satyam uktvā tu vipreṣu vikired yavasaṃ gavām |
analyzed: satyam uktvā tu vipreṣu vikiret yavasam gavām

original: gobhiḥ pravartite tīrthe kuryus tasya parigraham || 11.196 ||
analyzed: gobhiḥ pravartite tīrthe kuryuḥ tasya parigraham

original: satyam iti | ‘satyam etat punar asatpratigrahaṃ na kariṣyāmi’ ity evaṃ brāhmaṇeṣūktvā ghāsaṃ gavāṃ dadyāt | tasmin yavasaṃ bhakṣyamāne deśe gobhiḥ pavitrīkṛtatvāt tīrthībhūte brāhmaṇās tasya saṃvyavahāre svīkāraṃ kuryuḥ || 11.196 ||

original: yāmīr iti | sa jīvo yamakāritās tāḥ pīḍās tena kaṭhinadehenānubhūya tato bhogenāpahatapāpmā tān pañca jarāyujādiśarīrārambhakān pṛthivyādibhūtabhāgān adhitiṣthati | mānuṣādiśarīraṃ gṛhṇātīty arthaḥ || 12.22 ||

original: etā iti | asya jīvasya etā dharmādharmahetukāḥ svarganarakādyupabhogocitapriyāpriyadeha-prāptir antaḥkaraṇe jñātvā dharmānuṣṭhāne manaḥ sadā saṃgataṃ kuryāt || 12.23 ||
analyzed: etāḥ iti asya jīvasya etāḥ dharma adharma hetukāḥ svarga naraka ādi upabhoga ucita priya apriya deha prāptiḥ antaḥkaraṇe jñātvā dharma anuṣṭhāne manaḥ sadā saṃgatam kuryāt

original: sattvam iti | sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇi vakṣyamāṇaguṇalakṣaṇāni ātmopakārakatvād ātmano mahato guṇāñ jānīyāt, yair vyāpto mahān imān sthāvarajaṅgamarūpān padārthān niḥśeṣeṇa vyāpya sthitaḥ || 12.24 ||
analyzed: sattvam iti sattva rajaḥ tamāṃsi trīṇi vakṣyamāṇa guṇa lakṣaṇāni ātma upakāraka tvāt ātmanaḥ mahataḥ guṇān jānīyāt yaiḥ vyāptaḥ mahān imān sthāvara jaṅgama rūpān padārthān niḥśeṣeṇa vyāpya sthitaḥ

analyzed: sa tadā tad guṇa prāyam tam karoti śarīriṇam

original: ya iti | yady api sarvam evedaṃ triguṇaṃ tathāpi yatra dehe yeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye yo guṇo yadā sākalyenādhiko bhavati tadā tadguṇalakṣaṇabahulaṃ taṃ dehinaṃ karoti || 12.25 ||
analyzed: yaḥ iti yadi api sarvam eva idam triguṇam tathā api yatra dehe yeṣām guṇānām madhye yaḥ guṇaḥ yadā sākalyena adhikaḥ bhavati tadā tad guṇa lakṣaṇa bahulam tam dehinam karoti

original: saṃprati sattvādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam āha –

original: etad vyāptimad eteṣāṃ sarvabhūtāśritaṃ vapuḥ || 12.26 ||
analyzed: etat vyāptimat eteṣām sarva bhūta āśritam vapuḥ

original: sattvam iti | yathārthāvabhāso jñānaṃ tat sattvasya lakṣaṇam | etadviparītam ajñānaṃ tat tamolakṣaṇam | viṣādābhilāṣaṃ mānasakāryaṃ rajolakṣaṇam | svarūpaṃ tu sattvarajastamasāṃ prītyaprītiviṣādātmakam | tathā ca paṭhanti “prītiviṣādātmakāḥ prakāśavṛttiniyamārthā anyonyābhibhavajananamithunavṛttayaś ca guṇāḥ” | etac caiṣāṃ svarūpam anantaraślokatrayeṇa vakṣyati | eteṣāṃ sattvādiguṇānām etajjñānādi sarvaprāṇivyāpakaṃ lakṣaṇam || 12.26 ||
analyzed: sattvam iti yathārtha avabhāsaḥ jñānam tat sattvasya lakṣaṇam etad viparītam ajñānam tat tamaḥ lakṣaṇam viṣāda abhilāṣam mānasa kāryam rajaḥ lakṣaṇam svarūpam tu sattva rajaḥ tamasām prīti aprīti viṣāda ātmakam tathā ca paṭhanti prīti viṣāda ātmakāḥ prakāśa vṛtti niyama arthāḥ anyonya abhibhava janana mithuna vṛttayaḥ ca guṇāḥ etat ca eṣām svarūpam anantara śloka trayeṇa vakṣyati eteṣām sattva ādi guṇānām etat jñāna ād

original: praśāntam iva śuddhābhaṃ sattvaṃ tad upadhārayet || 12.27 ||

original: tatreti | tasminn ātmani yat saṃvedanaṃ prītiyuktaṃ pratyastamitakleśaṃ prakāśarūpam anubhavet tat sattvaṃ jānīyāt || 12.27 ||
analyzed: tatra iti tasmin ātmani yat saṃvedanam prīti yuktam pratyasta mita kleśam prakāśa rūpam anubhavet tat sattvam jānīyāt

original: yat tu duḥkhasamāyuktam aprītikaram ātmanaḥ |
analyzed: yat tu duḥkha samāyuktam aprīti karam ātmanaḥ

original: tad rajaḥ pratīpaṃ vidyāt satataṃ hāri dehinām || 12.28 ||
analyzed: tat rajaḥ pratīpam vidyāt satatam hāri dehinām

original: yat tv iti | yat punaḥ saṃvedanaṃ duḥkhānuviddham ata eva sattvaśuddhātmaprīter ajanakaṃ sarvadā ca śarīriṇāṃ viṣayaspṛhotpādakaṃ tattvanivārakāt pratipakṣaṃ rajo jānīyāt || 12.28 ||
analyzed: yat tu iti yat punar saṃvedanam duḥkha anuviddham atas eva sattva śuddha ātma prīteḥ ajanakam sarvadā ca śarīriṇām viṣaya spṛhā utpādakam tattva nivārakāt pratipakṣam rajaḥ jānīyāt

original: yat tu syān mohasaṃyuktam avyaktaṃ viṣayātmakam |
analyzed: yat tu syāt moha saṃyuktam avyaktam viṣaya ātmakam

original: apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ tamas tad upadhārayet || 12.29 ||
analyzed: apratarkyam avijñeyam tamaḥ tat upadhārayet

original: yat tv iti | yat punaḥ sadasadvivekaśūnyam asphuṭaviṣayākārasvabhāvam atarkanīyasvarūpam antaḥkaraṇabahiḥkaraṇābhyāṃ durjñātaṃ tat tamo jānīyāt | eṣāṃ ca guṇānāṃ svarūpakathanaṃ sattvavṛttyavasthitau yatnavatā bhavitavyam ity etat prayojanakam || 12.29 ||
analyzed: yat tu iti yat punar sat asat viveka śūnyam asphuṭa viṣaya ākāra svabhāvam atarkanīya svarūpam antaḥkaraṇa bahiḥkaraṇābhyām durjñātam tat tamaḥ jānīyāt eṣām ca guṇānām svarūpa kathanam sattva vṛtti avasthitau yatnavatā bhavitavyam iti etat prayojanakam

original: trayāṇām api caiteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ yaḥ phalodayaḥ |

original: agryo madhyo jaghanyaś ca taṃ pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 12.30 ||
analyzed: agryaḥ madhyaḥ jaghanyaḥ ca tam pravakṣyāmi aśeṣatas

original: trayāṇām iti | eteṣāṃ sattvādīnāṃ trayāṇām api guṇānāṃ yathākramam uttamamadhyamādhamarūpo yaḥ phalotpādakas taṃ viśeṣeṇa vakṣyāmi || 12.30 ||
analyzed: trayāṇām iti eteṣām sattva ādīnām trayāṇām api guṇānām yathākramam uttama madhyama adhama rūpaḥ yaḥ phala utpādakaḥ tam viśeṣeṇa vakṣyāmi

original: vedābhyāsas tapo jñānaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
analyzed: veda abhyāsaḥ tapaḥ jñānam śaucam indriya nigrahaḥ

original: dharmakriyātmacintā ca sāttvikaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.31 ||
analyzed: dharma kriyā ātma cintā ca sāttvikam guṇa lakṣaṇam

original: vedābhyāsa iti | vedābhyāsaḥ, prājāpatyādyanuṣṭhānaṃ, śāstrārthāvabodhaḥ, mṛdvāryādiśaucaṃ, indriyasaṃyamaḥ, dānādidharmānuṣṭhānaṃ, ātmadhyānaparatā, etat sattvākhyaguṇasya kāryam || 12.31 ||
analyzed: veda abhyāsaḥ iti veda abhyāsaḥ prājāpatya ādi anuṣṭhānam śāstra artha avabodhaḥ mṛd vāri ādi śaucam indriya saṃyamaḥ dāna ādi dharma anuṣṭhānam ātma dhyāna para tā etat sattva ākhya guṇasya kāryam

original: ārambharucitādharyam asatkāryaparigrahaḥ |
analyzed: ārambha ruci tā adharyam asat kārya parigrahaḥ

original: viṣayopasevā cājasraṃ rājasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.32 ||
analyzed: viṣaya upasevā ca ajasram rājasam guṇa lakṣaṇam

original: ārambheti | phalārthaṃ karmānuṣṭhānaśīlatā, alpe ‘py arthe vaiklavyaṃ, niṣiddhakarmācaraṇaṃ, ajasraṃ śabdādiviṣayopabhoga ity etad rajo’bhidhānaguṇasya kāryam || 12.32 ||
analyzed: ārambha iti phala artham karma anuṣṭhāna śīla tā alpe pi arthe vaiklavyam niṣiddha karma ācaraṇam ajasram śabda ādi viṣaya upabhogaḥ iti etat rajaḥ abhidhāna guṇasya kāryam

original: lobhaḥ svapno ‘dhṛtiḥ krauryaṃ nāstikyaṃ bhinnavṛttitā |
analyzed: lobhaḥ svapnaḥ dhṛtiḥ krauryam nāstikyam bhinna vṛtti tā

original: yāciṣṇutā pramādaś ca tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.33 ||
analyzed: yāciṣṇu tā pramādaḥ ca tāmasam guṇa lakṣaṇam

original: lobha ityādi | adhikādhikadhanaspṛhā, nidrātmatā, kātaryaṃ, paiśunyaṃ, paralokābhāvabuddhiḥ, ācāraparilopaḥ, yācanaśīlatvaṃ, saṃbhave ‘pi dharmādiṣv anavadhānaṃ, ity etat tāmasābhidhānasya guṇasya lakṣaṇam || 12.33 ||
analyzed: lobhaḥ ityādi adhika adhika dhana spṛhā nidrā ātma tā kātaryam paiśunyam para loka abhāva buddhiḥ ācāra parilopaḥ yācana śīla tvam saṃbhave dharma ādiṣu anavadhānam iti etat tāmasa abhidhānasya guṇasya lakṣaṇam

original: trayāṇām api caiteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ triṣu tiṣṭhatām |
analyzed: trayāṇām api ca eteṣām guṇānām triṣu tiṣṭhatām

original: idaṃ sāmāsikaṃ jñeyaṃ kramaśo guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.34 ||
analyzed: idam sāmāsikam jñeyam kramaśas guṇa lakṣaṇam

original: trayāṇām iti | eṣāṃ sattvādīnāṃ trayāṇām api guṇānām triṣu kāleṣu bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamāneṣu vidyamānānām idaṃ vakṣyamāṇasāpekṣikaṃ krameṇa guṇalakṣaṇaṃ jñātavyam || 12.34 ||
analyzed: trayāṇām iti eṣām sattva ādīnām trayāṇām api guṇānām triṣu kāleṣu bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamāneṣu vidyamānānām idam vakṣyamāṇa sāpekṣikam krameṇa guṇa lakṣaṇam jñātavyam

analyzed: yena iti ihaloke mahatīm khyātim prāpnuyām iti etad artham eva yaḥ yat karma karoti na para loka artham na ca tad karma phala asaṃpattau duḥkhī bhavati tat rajaḥ karya tvāt rajaḥ guṇa lakṣaṇam vijñeyam

original: yad iti | yat karma vedārthaṃ sarvātmanā jñātum icchati, yac ca karmācaran kālatraye ‘pi na lajjati, yena yena karmaṇāsyātmatuṣṭir jāyate, tat sattvākhyasya guṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam

analyzed: tamasaḥ iti kāma pradhāna tā tamasaḥ lakṣaṇam artha niṣṭhatā rajasaḥ dharma pradhāna tā sattvasya eṣām ca kāma ādīnām uttarottarasya śreṣṭha tvam kāmāt arthaḥ śreyān artha mūla tvāt kāmasya tābhyām ca dharmaḥ tad mūla tvāt tayoḥ

analyzed: yena ityādi eṣām sattva ādīnām guṇānām madhye yena guṇena sva kāryeṇa yāḥ gatīḥ jīvaḥ prāpnoti tāḥ sarvasya asya jagataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ krameṇa vakṣyāmi

original: devatvam iti | ye sattvavṛttāv avasthitās te devatvaṃ yānti | ye tu rajovṛttyavasthitās te manuṣyatvam | ye tamovṛttisthās te tiryaktvaṃ cety eṣā trividhā janmaprāptiḥ || 12.40 ||
analyzed: deva tvam iti ye sattva vṛttau avasthitāḥ te deva tvam yānti ye tu rajaḥ vṛtti avasthitāḥ te manuṣya tvam ye tamaḥ vṛtti sthāḥ te tiryaktvam ca iti eṣā trividhā janma prāptiḥ

original: trividhā trividhaiṣā tu vijñeyā gauṇikī gatiḥ |

original: trividheti | yā sattvādiguṇatrayanimittā trividhā janmāntaraprāptir uktā sā deśakālādibhedena saṃsārahetubhūtakarmabhedāj jñānabhedāc cādhamamadhyamottamabhedena punas trividhā boddhavyā || 12.41 ||

analyzed: paśavaḥ ca mṛgāḥ ca eva jaghanyā tāmasī gatiḥ

original: sthāvarā iti | sthāvarā vṛkṣādayaḥ, kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmāḥ prāṇinaḥ, tebhya īṣatsthūlāḥ kīṭāḥ, tathā matsyasarpakūrmapaśumṛgāś cety eṣā tamonimittā jaghanyā gatiḥ || 12.42 ||

analyzed: siṃhāḥ vyāghrāḥ varāhāḥ ca madhyamā tāmasī gatiḥ

original: hastinaś ceti | hastyaśvaśūdramlecchasiṃhavyāghrasūkarās tamoguṇanimittā madhyamā gatiḥ | garhitā iti mlecchānāṃ svarūpānuvādaḥ || 12.43 ||
